beats.event: George and Lennie travel toward Soledad after fleeing Weed
Share a dream of owning their own farm with rabbits
Hired at a Salinas ranch as field hands
Curley, the owner's aggressive son, targets Lennie
Curley's flirtatious wife catches Lennie's eye
Slim gifts Lennie a puppy from his dog's litter
Candy's old dog is shot by Carlson; Candy grieves
Candy offers $350; the farm dream leaps toward reality
Lennie crushes Curley's hand in a one-sided fight
Lennie visits Crooks; the wife bursts in and threatens him
Lennie accidentally kills his puppy while stroking it
Panicked, Lennie breaks Curley's wife's neck and flees
Ranch hands find her body; a lynch mob forms
George realises the dream is dead; races to the meeting spot
George shoots Lennie mid-story, sparing him the mob
Slim leads a broken George away; the others uncomprehending
